channel.title: Cointelegraph.com News
channel.description: Cointelegraph covers fintech, blockchain and Bitcoin bringing you the latest crypto news.

item.title: CFTC seeks public input on AI compute futures contracts as CME eyes October launch
item.description: The regulatory review could shape an emerging market that lets companies and investors trade and hedge the cost of increasingly scarce AI computing power.

item.title: US Treasury moves forward with rules on GENIUS Act after July deadline
item.description: The stablecoin bill signed into law last year is scheduled to go into effect in January 2027, potentially without finalized regulations from US government agencies.

item.title: Bitcoin hits $64K as gold gains while oil shakes off Trump Oman threat
item.description: Bitcoin price strength saw BTC/USD pass $64,000 on 2% daily gains as gold pushed higher while US stocks wobbled on fresh US-Iran rhetoric.

item.title: Bitmine nears 5% of Ethereum supply despite $8.4B in unrealized losses
item.description: Tom Lee's Ethereum treasury company keeps buying the second-biggest crypto through the downturn, while more than 5 million staked ETH is projected to generate $287 million in annual rewards.

item.title: Strategy raises $334M through stock sales but buys no Bitcoin
item.description: Proceeds funded STRC dividends and repurchases, while $149.1 million was added to Strategy's US dollar reserve, which reached $4.8 billion.

item.title: Harmony plans rollback, wiping 109,000 transactions after ONE exploit
item.description: Harmony said selectively restoring transactions could create inconsistent chain state, as Ravencoin faces a separate rollback dispute after an exploit.

item.title: BTC price loses 200-week trend line as 2022 repeats: Five things to know in Bitcoin this week
item.description: Bitcoin confirmed a weekly candle close below its 200-week moving average, copying the 2022 bear-market as traders warn of further BTC price downside next.

item.title: Binance gave Russian authorities client data used in terrorism financing case: Report
item.description: Reuters reported that Binance supplied transaction records and identity documents later used in a terrorism-financing case.

item.title: Bitpanda fined in Austria's first published MiCA penalty
item.description: The FMA said Bitpanda breached MiCA rules on crypto white papers and marketing communications, with the decision now final.

item.title: BitMart account demands founder explain funds status, Xia calls claims 'fabricated'
item.description: BitMart's Chinese-language X account demanded an Aug. 19 repayment plan, while Sheldon Xia called its claims of blocked withdrawals and non-payment of salaries "fabricated rumors."

item.title: Greenlane's $70M BERA treasury ends Q2 valued at $16M
item.description: Greenlane recorded a $19.1 million noncash valuation loss as BERA's price fell nearly 76% year to date.

item.title: Chainalysis sues US over $95M ICE contract with TRM Labs
item.description: The sealed complaint leaves Chainalysis' specific objections and requested remedy undisclosed as briefing continues.

item.title: Data of 54,000 wallet users leaked, CLARITY odds just 10%: Hodler's Digest
item.description: Owners of Trezor and SafePal crypto wallets at high risk of phishing attempts after separate data leaks, CLARITY odds at 10% despite White House meeting this week.

item.title: DefiLlama delayed mobile launch over phishing apps on Apple Store, founder says
item.description: DefiLlama's founder said Apple removed one fake app within days after the company documented it draining funds from a small crypto wallet.

item.title: Ethereum devs to narrow 66 proposals tied to Hegota upgrade
item.description: The Hegota upgrade aims to introduce more native privacy for Ethereum applications.

item.title: Bybit adds Unitree, Moonshot AI to pre-IPO perpetuals lineup
item.description: The additions come as Bybit's TradFi perpetuals lineup grows to more than 200 products spanning equities, ETFs, commodities, indices and private companies.

item.title: Tokenized stock holders more than double as monthly volume surges
item.description: Tokenized equities reached 1.31 million holders over the past month, as monthly transfer volume surged 179% to $23.13 billion and distributed value rose 5.9% to $2.38 billion.

item.title: Bitcoin to $1M by 2030 is 'mathematically impossible' says Markus Thielen
item.description: The trillions required to boost Bitcoin to a price of $1 million per coin is not going to happen by 2030... or perhaps ever, says party pooper Markus Thielen.

item.title: Bitcoin could bottom in October, altcoins are 'basically dead,' Swan CEO says
item.description: Klippsten said Bitcoin could bottom about a year after its previous peak and argued that crypto's best outcome is to become part of TradFi.

item.title: Kalshi ordered to stop broad range of prediction markets in Washington
item.description: Kalshi must implement initial geofencing by Aug. 19 and a GeoComply multi-source geofencing system by Sept. 2.

item.title: Galaxy lowers CLARITY Act odds to 10%
item.description: Galaxy cited unresolved ethics, stablecoin yield and developer protection issues, along with a narrow Senate window when lawmakers return in September.

item.title: Gen Z favors ETFs and trades less than older cohorts: Binance
item.description: Binance data showed Gen Z allocating a growing share of equity activity to ETFs while trading less frequently and using less leverage than older working-age cohorts.

item.title: Ireland plans industry standards for illicit crypto use
item.description: The proposed policies under Ireland's AML framework included stricter measures on transfers from private crypto wallets and overseas digital asset companies.

item.title: Dartmouth endowment's crypto exposure drops by $2M amid falling prices
item.description: The value of the university endowment's holdings in the Bitwise Solana staking ETF, Grayscale Ethereum staking ETF and BlackRock's iShares Bitcoin ETF dropped to about $12 million.

item.title: Kraken parent Payward revenue rises 17% as trading volume falls in Q2
item.description: Payward grew revenue despite weaker crypto spot activity, as funded accounts jumped 42% and a growing share of revenue came from outside transaction-based activity.

item.title: Israel's largest bank taps Galaxy to offer Bitcoin, Ether, Solana trading
item.description: Bank Leumi customers will be able to buy, hold and sell three major cryptocurrencies directly through the bank's investment app beginning in early 2027.

item.title: Crypto Biz: Bitcoin's $116M self-custody wake-up call
item.description: A $116 million Bitcoin wallet exploit puts self-custody under scrutiny as ETF inflows rebound, Strategy eyes more BTC and miners chase billions in AI deals.

item.title: Bitcoin price drops to $62.5K as trader warns weekly close may spark more losses
item.description: Bitcoin falls further toward new August lows, ignoring positive US inflation trends while US stocks continue to circle all-time highs.
